Energy uses recorded consumption, terrain and available wind forecasts. The model assumes a mass of 1,650 kg and approximate downhill energy recovery. AC limit is 11 kW for e-CMP and 22 kW for Zoe; DC time includes an approximate charging taper. Waiting for an available charger is not included.
Energija se dobija integracijom snage ba: Energy is calculated by integrating battery power V × I over time. Negative power while driving indicates regeneration. Intervals up to 60 s between readings are included. Energy during longer gaps is unknown.
Energija se računa integracijom snage ba: Energy is calculated by integrating battery power over time. Gross use adds discharge, recovered energy adds regeneration, and net energy is their difference. Gaps between readings can reduce calculation coverage.
Fabrička CATL kriva za tačnu ćeliju ovog: The manufacturer's CATL curve for this vehicle's exact cell has not been confirmed. Absolute SOC and separate upper/lower buffers remain unknown. Range uses vehicle SOC.

energy uses recorded consumption, terrain and available wind forecasts. The model assumes a mass of 1,650 kg and approximate downhill energy recovery. AC limit is 11 kW for e-CMP and 22 kW for Zoe; DC time includes an approximate charging taper. Waiting for an available charger is not included.
energija se dobija integracijom snage ba: energy is calculated by integrating battery power V × I over time. Negative power while driving indicates regeneration. Intervals up to 60 s between readings are included. Energy during longer gaps is unknown.
energija se računa integracijom snage ba: energy is calculated by integrating battery power over time. Gross use adds discharge, recovered energy adds regeneration, and net energy is their difference. Gaps between readings can reduce calculation coverage.
fabrička catl kriva za tačnu ćeliju ovog: the manufacturer's CATL curve for this vehicle's exact cell has not been confirmed. Absolute SOC and separate upper/lower buffers remain unknown. Range uses vehicle SOC.

soc očitava sistem vozila. njegova skala: sOC is reported by the vehicle. Its scale represents the usable battery range. The BMS uses voltage, current flow and its battery model. Separate upper and lower buffers for this vehicle have not been established.
soh je procena zdravlja koju vraća bms,: sOH is the BMS health estimate relative to its reference capacity. Temperature, previous cycles and calibration affect it. Where group SOH is available, it applies to the parallel group. Recorded driving or a controlled test is needed to estimate available energy.

snaga baterije se računa kao napon × str: battery power is voltage × current ÷ 1,000, in kW. Positive means consumption; negative means energy input. Separately measured motor power may differ because the battery also supplies other loads.
mean voltage D43D/D440 is not fresh.
srednji napon iz bms-a ili aritmetički p: bMS mean voltage or the arithmetic mean of a complete array (108 groups for e-CMP, 96 for Zoe). The newer available reading is used. If neither is available, pack voltage divided by the selected vehicle's series-group count may be used. Source and time are given in the voltage-based SOC explanation.
struja visokonaponske baterije je očitav: hV battery current is a BMS reading. In this app, positive means discharge and negative means charging or regeneration.

temperatura je očitana iz odgovarajućeg: temperature comes from the corresponding vehicle sensor. e-CMP reads 54 battery probes; Zoe reads 12. Average, minimum and maximum use readings returned by the BMS. Probe numbers indicate logical order.
